CustomField.description: Allows the Account Location to be captured again from a rep's phone (accountLocationCapture component). Ticked by a System Administrator or a user with the Account Location Override permission set. Unticked automatically when the new location is saved, so each tick allows one update. Author: Tharun N | Date: 04-11-2026
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to let a rep update this account's location once from their phone. It unticks itself after the location is saved.
CustomField.label: Override Location
